title: Opening a Chicago club with Jimmy Noone and Earl Hines
summary: Hall opened a club with Noone and Hines, and left after trouble with a married coat-check girl.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Yeah. They changed the name after that. So we were working at the place. I was working at the place.

So we went to work there. So I worked there while with Jimmy, Earl Hines. We had a good job.

So finally I had a little run in with a girl there, you know, working in a check room and come to find out she was married. So that broke that up. So she started disturbing. At the meantime, Ora set for me to come to Los Angeles to work at a Texas dance hall, because the drummer they had had two jobs.
